title: Period of a Sine with Pi in the Argument
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine the amplitude and period of $y=\sin(\pi x)$ and state how many cycles fit into an interval of length $2$.

steps.title: Match the Standard Form
steps.explanation: The argument coefficient is $B=\pi$ and there is no vertical scaling.
steps.why: Identifying $B$ correctly is everything for the period computation.

steps.title: State the Amplitude
steps.explanation: The outputs remain between $-1$ and $1$, so the wave keeps unit height.
steps.why: Only the outer multiplier changes amplitude.

steps.title: Compute the Period
steps.explanation: Cancelling $\pi$ leaves period $2$; hence exactly one full cycle occurs on every interval of length $2$.
steps.why: The $\pi$ coefficient compresses the standard $2\pi$-cycle down to length two.
